title: Acceptance with probability one
statement: Let $T$ be a nonadaptive function tester with a finite seed space, a probability distribution on that space, and a deterministic acceptance rule, and let $f$ be a function from its domain to its alphabet. The acceptance probability of $T$ on $f$ equals $1$ if and only if every seed in the support of the seed distribution causes $T$ to accept $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive function tester with finite seed space and a probability distribution on that space
$f$ maps the tester's domain to its alphabet
